description: A garden on atpota.to: a grid of plots anyone can plant a flower in. atpota.to's community patches live in its own repo, one per season; anyone can keep their own garden in theirs, by convention at record key "self". Flowers point at it with a strong ref. It is open from opensAt (or createdAt, without one) until closesAt, if it has one.

name.description: What the garden is called, like "autumn 2026" or "dame's garden".

opensAt.description: Flowers can be planted from this time; without it, from createdAt.

closesAt.description: Planting ends at this time; the flowers stay, pressed, in full bloom. Without it, the garden stays open.
